verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-4 approval remains supported. The manual Anthropic form now carries the provider cap of 4, while the operator guidance consistently identifies OpenAI's cap of 12 and full alias set. The self-test reads the live form prefill, passes it through the allocator's real parser and schema validation, and compares the parsed provider/cap against both the executed broker derivation and an independent pinned tuple. Its extractor tests cover missing and duplicate fields, absent/inline/empty values, neighboring fields, non-text inputs, and sibling boundaries; wrapper false paths are also asserted without allowing exceptions to masquerade as mutation kills. The documented absent and non-numeric fallback behavior matches the allocator. I found no correctness, soundness, fail-closed, test-validity, injection, or security issue in the diff.
